about.title: About
about.p1: Welcome to Commonwealth School, a place dedicated to the awakening, well-being and development of children from 6 months to 6 years old.
about.p2: Our mission is to offer a warm, safe and stimulating environment where every child can grow, learn and thrive at their own pace. Through a caring pedagogical approach, we encourage curiosity, autonomy, creativity and self-confidence from the earliest years of life.
about.p3: At Commonwealth School, we believe education is a partnership between school and family. That is why we place essential importance on supporting parents and maintaining close communication to foster each child's harmonious development.
about.p4: Our qualified teams offer varied activities, awakening workshops, creative experiences and moments of discovery that allow each child to learn by exploring the world around them.
about.p5: Together, let us make the first years of learning an adventure rich in discoveries, smiles and achievements.

classes.title: Classes
classes.intro: Logical-mathematical intelligence is the ability to reason, deduce and identify patterns. In toddlers, it shows through a need to understand the "why" of things, the pleasure of sorting, classifying and ordering, and a fascination with cause-and-effect relationships.

vision.title: A shared vision
vision.body: Commonwealth Preschool of Abidjan combines excellence with the Finnish approach to early childhood education to build an innovative, forward-looking pedagogy.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.p1: At Commonwealth School, we believe every child is unique and deserves an environment where they can grow with confidence, learn with joy and fully develop their potential.
approach.p2: Our educational approach is built on learning through exploration, play and everyday experiences. We encourage curiosity, autonomy, creativity and self-confidence through activities tailored to each stage of a child's development.
approach.p3: We also foster a trusting relationship with families, convinced that collaboration between parents and the teaching team is essential to every child's wellbeing.
approach.p4: In a safe, caring and stimulating setting, we guide children from 6 months to 6 years through their first discoveries and prepare them calmly for tomorrow's learning.

values.title: Our values
values.intro: Commonwealth School draws on both international excellence and African cultural heritage. Its identity combines the fern's message of resilience with a modern vision of integral, human education. It celebrates diversity, the strength of the collective and the power of learning together, forming grounded, confident and caring citizens.
values.shareBody: Learning to give, receive and build together with respect for everyone.
values.curiosityBody: Question, explore and learn without limits—in joy and wonder.
values.collabBody: Growing together, respecting differences and building a supportive community.

workshops.title: Discovery Workshops
workshops.p1: Through fun, creative, sensory and educational activities, each workshop sparks curiosity, develops the child's abilities and strengthens the parent-child bond in a caring, secure environment.
workshops.p2: Come explore, learn, create and grow together at your child's pace.
